summary: Blue Moon Metals filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a C$156 million bought-deal public offering and concurrent private placement of common shares. The company issued 10,625,000 prospectus shares and 5,000,000 private placement shares, each at C$10.00 per share. Scotiabank, ATB Cormark, and Canaccord Genuity acted as joint bookrunners; underwriters received C$7,756,250 in cash commissions. The offering was completed under a prospectus supplement to a base shelf prospectus in Canada and the U.S. via Form F-10. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation event, so no deal terms or strategic changes apply.
